text:
zoe_cs: heads-up — Prospecta renewal. Procurement wants split invoicing (US / APAC), a 6-month term instead of 12, and wants onboarding to kick off once they upload the PO. price + legal alignment needed.
raj_sales: looping @harper_legal @lucas_fin. any immediate no-gos for split-entity SOWs or start-on-PO?
harper_legal: doable. SOW must enumerate each legal entity and include billing lines + tax appendix. start-on-PO OK only for pre-kickoff activities (view access/reserved seats). full warranty/indemnities still require countersign.
lucas_fin: finance note — 6mo proration ~54% of annual. to protect margin propose +3% uplift on the prorated subtotal. need product sign-off; also require vendor code and PO number on invoices.
maya_onboard: we can reserve 2 enablement seats and run pre-kickoff workshops. SSO/production provisioning waits for signed contract or PO with explicit acceptance clause.
zoe_cs: customer response at 1743217200: willing to accept 6mo +3% and keep 2 onboarding credits. they plan to upload PO today and will include vendor code.
raj_sales: sent PO template + draft amendment via docuSign at 1743217805. asked for exact legal names and VAT/EIN details. tracking id: RENEW-1743.
renewal-bot: reminder — renewal:prospecta in 5 days. tasks: legal amendment, pricing ok, PO template, DocuSign countersign.
zoe_cs: marking renewal row non-standard: "split-billing" + "start-on-PO". will hold full activations until PO/signature but run pre-kickoff.

Sample PO/invoice snippet shared with customer:
```
Line 1:
- entity: Prospecta, Inc (EIN: 98-1234567)
- scope: US seats + onboarding credits
Line 2:
- entity: Prospecta APAC Pte Ltd (UEN: 201800999A)
- scope: APAC seats
Vendor code: PROS-APAC
Payment terms: Net30 (PO required). please include PO# on invoice.
```

raj_sales: will follow up EOD if PO not uploaded. :thumbsup:
